messages:
maria (partnerships): FYI — Datadog PS asked about our sampling defaults for the embedded marketplace tile demo next week. They want to avoid missing traces in the press run. Can eng confirm current sampling config for staging vs prod?

sam (eng-ml): staging uses full sampling (1.0) by default. Prod has parent-based sampling with default 0.1. We have a feature flag to override per-service. gist with config: https://gist.github.com/redwood/abc123 (sample snippet below)
```
tracing:
  sampler:
    type: parent_based
    default_rate: 0.1
  overrides:
    redwood-runtime: 0.7
```

jordan (observability): For the marketplace demo we should pick a single canonical sampling rule so dashboards match screenshots. Proposal: service.redwood-runtime -> sample_rate=0.7, http 5xx -> 1.0, dev/demo env -> 1.0. Also ensure trace-context preserved across the proxy layer (x-b3 / traceparent). I'll add to the telemetry checklist.

anya (marketing): Press slot is Wed 3pm PT. We need final dashboard snapshots + exported traces for Datadog by Tue EOD. Also need a short runbook (2 bullets) for on-stage fallback if traces look noisy.

deploy-bot: "Deployment v2.4.1 to staging succeeded. telemetry.feature_flag=on; telemetry.sampling=demo-profile" :rocket: 

nick (si): SI partner (EdgeScale) needs OTLP mapping validation for our collector config. They reported missing attributes in resource.service.name for some air-gapped customers. cc @oliver (datadog) — can you validate mapping?

oliver (datadog): I can validate tomorrow AM. Prefer receiving a small sample payload (OTLP v1) + a recording of a demo trace (zip). If you can attach via the secure share link that'd be great. Also, we recommend adding a processing pipeline rule to copy resource.service.namespace -> service.namespace if needed.

jordan (observability): Suggested sampling rules to add to runbook (quick copy):
```
- rule: service.name == "redwood-runtime" -> sample_rate: 0.7
- rule: http.status_code >= 500 -> sample_rate: 1.0
- rule: env == "demo" -> sample_rate: 1.0
```

maria (partnerships): Thanks — action items: 1) @sam add demo-profile to staging and export trace bundle to secure share by Mon noon; 2) @jordan publish checklist + dashboard snapshot template; 3) @oliver validate OTLP mapping by Tue morning; 4) @anya confirm press timing and fallback copy. If all green we'll announce marketplace tile demo to partners on Tue 5pm PT. :thumbsup:

sam (eng-ml): On it — I'll push the demo-profile config and paste the secure-share link here when ready.

oliver (datadog): Got it, will run quick validation and send back notes.

anya (marketing): Adding fallback script: "If traces missing, switch to demo-tracing-mode and use pre-captured dashboard screenshots" and save to drive: https://drive.redwood.co/press/demos/wed

maria (partnerships): Great. Closing thread after verification. If anyone hits issues ping #eng-oncall and @deploy-bot for quick rollback. :raised_hands:
